name: Sutrix
long_description:
Sutrix helps healthcare providers prepare and license clinical data to pharma companies and AI labs. We've reached 20k mrr working with research teams to prepare patient data and are now using that same software to turn years of fragmented medical records into longitudinal datasets that capture patient journeys, treatment decisions and outcomes.

We’re brothers who built HSS’s injury surveillance system, used by 700+ teams. Ritvik is a published clinical researcher at HSS and Emory. Supratik built production AI agents at Amazon and previously founded an AI security company backed by a16z Speedrun.
one_liner: Transforming how healthcare providers monetize clinical data.
